name: Playhead
notes:
**Design polish**
- Dialogs, sheets, menus and the update card sit on a near-solid surface, so text stays readable over any content (including over video in the player).
- One consistent set of corner radii and one height per control type across the app.
- Detail and person pages start at the top instead of floating mid-screen.
- A cleaner search field, evenly inset dividers in Settings, a tidier onboarding card, and see-through cards in the source list.

Windows stays on build 6 for this test release.
